# Homebrew Tap for Faucet

Official Homebrew tap for [Faucet](https://github.com/faucetdb/faucet) — turn any database into a secure REST API.

## Install

```bash
brew tap faucetdb/tap
brew install faucet
```

## Upgrade

```bash
brew update
brew upgrade faucet
```

## About

This tap is automatically updated by [GoReleaser](https://goreleaser.com/) when new Faucet versions are released.

For more information, visit [faucet.dev](https://faucet.dev).
